stable.notes: The pet stops repeating itself. Running is a burst rather than a treadmill — a session is working almost all the time, so the sprint now settles between bursts, and settled beats rotate through every solo sequence the character has: breathing idle, meditation, draw-and-flourish, and guard. The character also holds one size and one baseline through an animation. Jedi Miles Windu ships as the default with ten animated states and 74 frames. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
